decontamination: evaluation_query_texts is EMPTY in this build on purpose: the 4,000 evaluation rows' query text may not be read without a model-free ledger row, so the 6-gram decontamination against the evaluation roster is performed by the flight agent under its own row. Every note word is already constrained to the registry columns of its own target, which the builder enforces.

token_method: MEASURED on the flight tokenizer, never estimated: the resident llama-server's /tokenize route at the cell's own serving geometry counts every rendering this receipt reports, and scripts/build_a2t_contrast_notes.py refuses --write without --tokenizer-url. The retired method was an ESTIMATE -- rendered characters divided by 3.989, ORG-1's ratio -- and it priced these notes at +40 tokens when the tokenizer says +44, which is why the 2026-09-06 owner ruling makes the measurement the authority and the +40 headroom a reported figure rather than a gate.

whole_block_token_equality.rule: the two arms' whole rendered blocks must measure the same token count
